q: By December 31, 2027, Germany's Ministry of Defense or the Bundeswehr officially announces that the 45th Panzer Brigade stationed in Lithuania has reached full operational readiness (volle Einsatzbereitschaft)
basis: The Bundeswehr plans to finish forming the brigade in the second half of 2027 and to bring it to full operational readiness, with at least 5,000 troops, before the end of 2027. A multinational battle group was folded into the brigade in February 2026. Even so, the creation of large units is often delayed by schedules for barracks and equipment.
rs: An announcement by the German Ministry of Defence or the Bundeswehr
